info.name: UniversityOS API
info.description:
Requests for the UniversityOS APIs that are implemented today: institutional authentication and the Book Management catalogue.

Responses use `{ "status": number, "message": string, "data": object }`. Errors use `{ "status": number, "message": string }` and do not include `data`.

Suggested order:
1. Create institution.
2. Register administrator. The test script stores the JWT in `token`.
3. Register student. That token is stored separately in `studentToken`.
4. Create author, publisher, category, subject, and genre.
5. Create book, then publish it.
6. List published books as a student.

The catalogue reads the institution from the JWT. Do not send `tenantId`. An `admin` account manages the catalogue. A `user` account can read published works only. A record owned by another institution is returned as 404 `Record not found`.

Import `UniversityOS Local` if you want to point `baseUrl` at another host. Leave `token` as a collection variable so the login script can fill it.

request.description: Load-balancer health check. Returns 200 when the Rails process is up.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Institution onboarding, registration, login, logout, and password reset. Login and registration accept `institutionCode`. The password reset call does not check an OTP. Call it only after the client has already verified the email.

request.description: Creates the tenant used by later registration and login calls. `code` is stored in uppercase and must be 2 to 50 letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
Registers an `admin` user. Catalogue writes require this account type. The returned JWT is stored in `token`.
Registers a `user` who can read the published catalogue. The JWT is stored in `studentToken` and does not replace the administrator token.
Returns `data.token` and `data.user`. The test script stores the token for the catalogue requests. `email` is also accepted as `emai`.
Stores the reader JWT in `studentToken`.
Sets a new password for an email that the client has already verified. This endpoint does not check an OTP or a deep link. `data` is the user profile and does not include a token.
Revokes the current JWT. Send an empty JSON body and the bearer token. Later calls with that token return `Token has been revoked`. Login again before calling the catalogue.

item.name: Languages and formats
item.description: Global reference data seeded with ISO language codes and the standard publication formats. Any authenticated user can read them.

request.description: Active languages. The test script stores the English id in `languageId`.
One active language. Run List languages first.
Active formats: HARDCOVER, PAPERBACK, EBOOK, AUDIOBOOK, LARGE_PRINT, BRAILLE, OTHER. Stores the paperback id in `formatId`.
One active format. Run List book formats first.

item.name: Authors
item.description: Tenant-scoped authors. Writes require an administrator. Archiving is in the final folder so these records stay available for Create book.

request.description: Paginated list for the signed-in institution. `data` contains `authors`, `page`, `perPage`, and `total`.
Creates a record in the signed-in institution and stores its id in `authorId`.

body.raw:
{
  "firstName": "Robert",
  "middleName": "C.",
  "lastName": "Martin",
  "displayName": "Robert C. Martin",
  "biography": "Software engineer and author.",
  "orcid": "0000-0002-1825-0097",
  "nationalityCode": "US",
  "aliases": [
    "Uncle Bob"
  ]
}

request.description: Returns one record owned by the signed-in institution.
Updates only the fields you send.

item.name: Books
item.description: Work records. Create always starts as `draft`, even if the body sends another status. ISBN belongs on the edition. Publishing, archival, and draft deletion are separate requests. Search filters are on List books; enable the ones you need.

request.description: Administrators see every status in their institution. Students see published works only. Sort accepts `title`, `author`, `publicationYear`, or `recent`. `titleMatch` accepts `exact` or `partial`.
Uses `studentToken`. Drafts are omitted. A draft id returns 404 rather than 403.

Creates one work, one edition, and a normalized ISBN-13. Run the author, publisher, and category requests first. Subjects and genres are linked by the associate requests. The script stores `bookId`, `editionId`, and `authorLinkId`. Change `catalogueNumber` before running this again.
A draft with no editions. Its id is stored in `draftBookId` so Delete draft can remove it.
Work, contributors, editions, identifiers, classifications, metadata, and an inventory summary. Copy counts are null until Inventory exists.
Updates work fields and replaces authors, subjects, categories, genres, or metadata when those keys are sent. Edition changes use the edition endpoints. Archived works return 409.
Adds one contributor. Roles: author, co_author, editor, translator, illustrator, compiler, contributor. The join id is stored in `authorLinkId`. A repeated author and role returns 409.
Removes one work-contributor link. `authorLinkId` is the association id, not the author id.
Links a subject. Set `primary` to true to make it the only primary subject. Delete uses the subject id.
Removes the subject from this work.
Links a category. Delete uses the category id.
Removes the category assignment.
Links a genre. Delete uses the genre id.
Removes the genre assignment.

Stores object-storage metadata for a cover. The binary is not uploaded here. Allowed types are image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, and image/gif. Maximum size is 5242880 bytes. Covers require alt text.
Moves a draft to `under_review`. Use a draft id. A published book cannot take this transition.
Moves `under_review` to `rejected`.
An administrator may publish a draft directly. Students receive 403. The response is the published work.
Moves a published work to `withdrawn`. It leaves the student catalogue and can later be archived.
Archives a published or withdrawn work. `circulationWarnings` is empty. Copy counts stay null. Existing loans are not changed by this call.
Administrator-only history for this work. `data.auditLogs` is newest first.
Hard-deletes a draft that has no editions. A published book, or a draft that still has editions, returns 409.

item.name: Editions
item.description: Published versions of a work. Identifiers and edition-specific contributors are added here. Only an edition of a draft can be deleted.

request.description: Editions of one work. Students can list editions of a published work.
Adds an edition and stores its id in `editionId`. Identifiers in this body are accepted on create. Later identifier changes use Add identifier.
Edition details, identifiers, contributors, and media. Students only receive an edition of a published work.
Updates edition fields that are present in the body. Sending `identifiers` here is rejected. Use Add identifier instead.
Adds ISBN_10, ISBN_13, DOI, OCLC, LCCN, or OTHER. ISBNs are validated and stored without hyphens. The same identifier cannot be repeated in one institution.
Associates a contributor with this edition only, for example the translator of one translation.
Deletes the edition when its work is still a draft. An edition of a published work returns 409. Audit rows remain on the work.

item.name: Archive records
item.description: Run these after catalogue setup. Archiving keeps the row and its links. An archived author or publisher cannot be newly assigned.

request.description: Marks the author archived. Existing book links remain.
Marks the publisher archived. Existing editions keep the publisher.
Marks the category archived.
Marks the subject archived.
Marks the genre archived.
